limits.authority: 勞基法 §32(2): 54 overtime hours a month where a union or the labour-management conference consents, inside the 138-hour quarter
勞基法 §30(1): normal hours may not exceed eight a day and forty a week — the hours past forty in a week are overtime whatever the day’s length.

work_rules.authority: 勞動基準法第24條第1項 — extended work is paid at no less than 4/3 of the ordinary hourly wage for the first two hours and 5/3 beyond, in force in this form since 2018-03-01; 第32條第2項 caps normal plus extended work at 12 hours a day, extended work at 46 hours a month and, where a union or a labour-management conference consents, at 138 hours in any three months; 第35條 gives 30 minutes' rest after four continuous hours; 第36條 gives two days' rest in every seven, one of them the 例假 that may not be worked; 第37條 and 紀念日及節日實施條例第8條 move a holiday that falls on a rest day to a 補假 rather than absorbing it; 第39條 pays a further day's wage for work on a holiday. Applied 2026-09-18: §30 the normal day is eight hours (`normal_hours`); §32(2) 54 overtime hours a month on consent (`limits[].when` over the entity fact `overtime_consent`); §35 proviso: for shift or continuous work the break is rescheduled inside working time and counts as worked (`shift_or_continuous_work`); §84-1: a NON_EA classification at an establishment with an approved 責任制 agreement is outside the overtime ladder (`responsibility_system`). Applied 2026-09-23: §24(1)(3) — hours extended under §32(4) (natural disaster, incident or emergency) are paid at double the ordinary hourly wage (`EMERGENCY-2.0X` over `emergency_cause`), and §32(2) caps only the §32(1) extension, so those hours count toward no ceiling (§36(3) says the same of rest-day work so forced); §32-1 — where the worker elects time off for a §32(1)–(2) extension or 休息日 work, the hours are credited hour for hour instead of paid (the ordinary-day and 休息日 ladders stand aside where `time_off_in_lieu` holds; not for 例假, holiday or §32(4) work, which §32-1 does not reach); hours untaken at the agreed expiry (no later than the end of the annual-leave year, 施行細則 §22-2) or on termination are paid by payroll at that day's overtime rates (`time_off_in_lieu`). Source: https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0030001

wages.authority: 最低工資法 §4–§5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030028&flno=5): NT$28,590 a month and NT$190 an hour. `hourly_by_region` holds an hourly rate (and a part-timer’s month, pro rata to its hours) to the hourly figure, and `scale` a daily rate to the hourly figure for the contract’s normal hours a day; a monthly salary is held to the monthly figure.

ordinary_rate_reference.authority: 勞動基準法施行細則 §24-1(2)(1)(2): 一日工資，為勞工之特別休假於年度終結或契約終止前一日之正常工作時間所得之工資。其為計月者，為年度終結或契約終止前最近一個月正常工作時間所得之工資除以三十所得之金額 — the normal-hours wage actually earned in the latest month, read from that month's payslips (the wage and each normal-hours allowance as prorated, a class marked WAGES such as commission, less unpaid days; overtime is not normal-hours pay). A mid-month raise and variable normal-hours pay are therefore the month's own figures. A month no payslip settled is read from an approved employment_wage_periods record. Daily and hourly wages keep the preceding day's agreed normal wage (encashment.day_amount). https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030002&flno=24-1

encashment.day_amount: terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.pay_frequency == "WEEKLY" ? terms.basic_salary / terms.working_days_per_week + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.monthly_wage / 30.0
encashment.authority: Labor Standards Act article 38(4); Enforcement Rules article 24-1(2). Monthly normal-working-hours pay uses the latest completed wage month, divided by 30. Hourly, daily or weekly pay uses the preceding day’s agreed normal working wage — only a wage 計月 is divided by thirty (§24-1(2)(1)(2): 其為計月者 ... 除以三十), so a weekly wage is not converted to a month; its day is the week’s normal-hours wage over the contract’s normal working days in that week; a NT$200 hourly worker with four normal hours receives NT$800 per unused day. Carried leave preserves the original year-end valuation. Normal-hours wage allowances must be classified explicitly. Source: https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/yqoj1nut/勞基法新制上路不動產經紀業調適指引.pdf?mediaDL=true

time_off_in_lieu.authority: 勞動基準法第32條之1 — where the worker chooses 補休 for a §32(1)–(2) extension or 休息日 work and the employer agrees, the hours are credited hour for hour; 補休期限由勞雇雙方協商, and hours untaken at the expiry or on termination are paid at that day's overtime rates (§32-1(2)). 施行細則第22條之2: 補休 is taken in the order the hours were worked (oldest first); an agreed period ending after the last day of the §24(2) annual-leave year ends on that day; the pay is due on the agreed pay day or within 30 days of expiry, and under §9 (immediately) on termination. MOL 加班補休規定 Q&A: the end of the annual-leave year is the final deadline and cannot be deferred. Payroll keeps the balance: each elected hour is credited on the payslip that settles its day at what its band would have paid; hours HR records as COMPENSATORY_TIME_OFF leave consume the oldest unexpired credit; a credit expires `time_off_in_lieu_months` (entity fact, the agreement) after its day, never later than the end of the ANNUAL_LEAVE year, and what is left is paid in the run whose salary window reaches the expiry or the exit. Sources: https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=32-1 ; https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030002&flno=22-2 ; https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/28162/28166/28180/28198/28202/

final_pay_deadlines.authority: Enforcement Rules of the Labour Standards Act art.9 (settle immediately); severance within 30 days

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.

Also check the BLI index pages 0005475/0106148/0011588 for the next 分級表. facts.label: Overtime consent
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §32(2): a month's overtime may exceed 46 hours, to 54 (138 a quarter), only with the consent of the union or, where there is none, the labour-management conference. Unrecorded is no consent — the statute's own 46-hour month.

facts.label: Shift or continuous work
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §35: 勞工繼續工作四小時，至少應有三十分鐘之休息。但實行輪班制或其工作有連續性或緊急性者，雇主得在工作時間內，另行調配其休息時間 — true where the entity runs shifts or continuous work and so rearranges the break inside working time. Unrecorded is the rule, not its exception: false.

facts.label: Approved responsibility system
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §84-1: an approved responsibility system (責任制) for a category the central authority has announced, with a written agreement filed with the local authority, sets hours outside §30, §32, §36, §37 and §49. It is an exception that must be approved; unrecorded is none: false.

facts.label: Pension reserve rate
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §56(1): 雇主應依勞工每月薪資總額百分之二至百分之十五範圍內，按月提撥勞工退休準備金 — the percentage the competent authority approved for this entity's 勞工退休準備金. Required once the entity has a worker on the old (LSA) pension system: the LABOR_PENSION_RESERVE scheme refuses the run by name while it is unrecorded; an entity with no such worker leaves it blank.

facts.label: Agreed 補休 period (months)
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §32-1(2): 補休期限由勞雇雙方協商 — the months after the day worked within which hours elected as 補休 are to be taken, as the worker and the employer agreed. Leave it unrecorded where no period was agreed: 施行細則 §22-2(1) and MOL's 加班補休規定 Q&A make the last day of the annual-leave year the final deadline, which also caps any longer agreement.

exit_facts.label: 勞基法 termination ground
exit_facts.description: The article the contract ended under. Severance is owed on §11, the §13 proviso, §14 and §20 (勞工退休金條例 §12, 勞基法 §17); notice pay on §11 and the §13 proviso (§16). OTHER owes neither. Required where the exit reason alone cannot tell the article: a dismissal (§11 owes severance, §12 does not), a unilateral or mutual termination, and a resignation (§14 owes severance, §15 does not); a redundancy or retrenchment is read as §11.

exit_facts.label: Average daily wage (平均工資)
exit_facts.description: 勞基法 §2(4): wages received in the six months before the termination day divided by the total days, excluding the periods in 施行細則 §2. Severance is 30 times this a month. Absent, a monthly-paid employee’s is read from the payslips; a daily or hourly one states it, since §2(4)’s proviso floors it at 60% of wages over the days actually worked.

exit_facts.label: Retained old-system seniority (months)
exit_facts.description: 勞工退休金條例 §11: service before the new pension system, retained, severed at one month’s average wage a year under 勞基法 §17 (a part month counts whole).

exit_facts.label: Notice days given
exit_facts.description: 勞基法 §16: calendar days from the day after notice to the last working day. The shortfall against 10 / 20 / 30 days is paid at the day wage.

name: Taiwan — 1 January 2026
change_summary: 民國115年 tables from the 29,500 minimum wage: 11 勞保 grades, 58 健保 grades, 勞退 grade 25 = 29,500 → 1,770, the non-resident 6% breakpoint at 44,250; the 2025-12-09 勞工請假規則 amendment and 育嬰留職停薪 day-unit flexibility; foreign professionals enter 勞退新制.

limits.authority: 勞基法 §32(2): 54 overtime hours a month where a union or the labour-management conference consents, inside the 138-hour quarter
勞基法 §30(1): normal hours may not exceed eight a day and forty a week — the hours past forty in a week are overtime whatever the day’s length.

work_rules.authority: 勞動基準法第24條第1項 — extended work is paid at no less than 4/3 of the ordinary hourly wage for the first two hours and 5/3 beyond, in force in this form since 2018-03-01; 第32條第2項 caps normal plus extended work at 12 hours a day, extended work at 46 hours a month and, where a union or a labour-management conference consents, at 138 hours in any three months; 第35條 gives 30 minutes' rest after four continuous hours; 第36條 gives two days' rest in every seven, one of them the 例假 that may not be worked; 第37條 and 紀念日及節日實施條例第8條 move a holiday that falls on a rest day to a 補假 rather than absorbing it; 第39條 pays a further day's wage for work on a holiday. Applied 2026-09-18: §30 the normal day is eight hours (`normal_hours`); §32(2) 54 overtime hours a month on consent (`limits[].when` over the entity fact `overtime_consent`); §35 proviso: for shift or continuous work the break is rescheduled inside working time and counts as worked (`shift_or_continuous_work`); §84-1: a NON_EA classification at an establishment with an approved 責任制 agreement is outside the overtime ladder (`responsibility_system`). Applied 2026-09-23: §24(1)(3) — hours extended under §32(4) (natural disaster, incident or emergency) are paid at double the ordinary hourly wage (`EMERGENCY-2.0X` over `emergency_cause`), and §32(2) caps only the §32(1) extension, so those hours count toward no ceiling (§36(3) says the same of rest-day work so forced); §32-1 — where the worker elects time off for a §32(1)–(2) extension or 休息日 work, the hours are credited hour for hour instead of paid (the ordinary-day and 休息日 ladders stand aside where `time_off_in_lieu` holds; not for 例假, holiday or §32(4) work, which §32-1 does not reach); hours untaken at the agreed expiry (no later than the end of the annual-leave year, 施行細則 §22-2) or on termination are paid by payroll at that day's overtime rates (`time_off_in_lieu`). Source: https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0030001

wages.authority: 最低工資法 §4–§5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030028&flno=5): NT$29,500 a month and NT$196 an hour. `hourly_by_region` holds an hourly rate (and a part-timer’s month, pro rata to its hours) to the hourly figure, and `scale` a daily rate to the hourly figure for the contract’s normal hours a day; a monthly salary is held to the monthly figure.

ordinary_rate_reference.authority: 勞動基準法施行細則 §24-1(2)(1)(2): 一日工資，為勞工之特別休假於年度終結或契約終止前一日之正常工作時間所得之工資。其為計月者，為年度終結或契約終止前最近一個月正常工作時間所得之工資除以三十所得之金額 — the normal-hours wage actually earned in the latest month, read from that month's payslips (the wage and each normal-hours allowance as prorated, a class marked WAGES such as commission, less unpaid days; overtime is not normal-hours pay). A mid-month raise and variable normal-hours pay are therefore the month's own figures. A month no payslip settled is read from an approved employment_wage_periods record. Daily and hourly wages keep the preceding day's agreed normal wage (encashment.day_amount). https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030002&flno=24-1

encashment.day_amount: terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.pay_frequency == "WEEKLY" ? terms.basic_salary / terms.working_days_per_week + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.monthly_wage / 30.0
encashment.authority: Labor Standards Act article 38(4); Enforcement Rules article 24-1(2). Monthly normal-working-hours pay uses the latest completed wage month, divided by 30. Hourly, daily or weekly pay uses the preceding day’s agreed normal working wage — only a wage 計月 is divided by thirty (§24-1(2)(1)(2): 其為計月者 ... 除以三十), so a weekly wage is not converted to a month; its day is the week’s normal-hours wage over the contract’s normal working days in that week; a NT$200 hourly worker with four normal hours receives NT$800 per unused day. Carried leave preserves the original year-end valuation. Normal-hours wage allowances must be classified explicitly. Source: https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/yqoj1nut/勞基法新制上路不動產經紀業調適指引.pdf?mediaDL=true

time_off_in_lieu.authority: 勞動基準法第32條之1 — where the worker chooses 補休 for a §32(1)–(2) extension or 休息日 work and the employer agrees, the hours are credited hour for hour; 補休期限由勞雇雙方協商, and hours untaken at the expiry or on termination are paid at that day's overtime rates (§32-1(2)). 施行細則第22條之2: 補休 is taken in the order the hours were worked (oldest first); an agreed period ending after the last day of the §24(2) annual-leave year ends on that day; the pay is due on the agreed pay day or within 30 days of expiry, and under §9 (immediately) on termination. MOL 加班補休規定 Q&A: the end of the annual-leave year is the final deadline and cannot be deferred. Payroll keeps the balance: each elected hour is credited on the payslip that settles its day at what its band would have paid; hours HR records as COMPENSATORY_TIME_OFF leave consume the oldest unexpired credit; a credit expires `time_off_in_lieu_months` (entity fact, the agreement) after its day, never later than the end of the ANNUAL_LEAVE year, and what is left is paid in the run whose salary window reaches the expiry or the exit. Sources: https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=32-1 ; https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030002&flno=22-2 ; https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/28162/28166/28180/28198/28202/

final_pay_deadlines.authority: Enforcement Rules of the Labour Standards Act art.9 (settle immediately); severance within 30 days

Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.

facts.label: Overtime consent
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §32(2): a month's overtime may exceed 46 hours, to 54 (138 a quarter), only with the consent of the union or, where there is none, the labour-management conference. Unrecorded is no consent — the statute's own 46-hour month.

facts.label: Shift or continuous work
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §35: 勞工繼續工作四小時，至少應有三十分鐘之休息。但實行輪班制或其工作有連續性或緊急性者，雇主得在工作時間內，另行調配其休息時間 — true where the entity runs shifts or continuous work and so rearranges the break inside working time. Unrecorded is the rule, not its exception: false.

facts.label: Approved responsibility system
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §84-1: an approved responsibility system (責任制) for a category the central authority has announced, with a written agreement filed with the local authority, sets hours outside §30, §32, §36, §37 and §49. It is an exception that must be approved; unrecorded is none: false.

facts.label: Pension reserve rate
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §56(1): 雇主應依勞工每月薪資總額百分之二至百分之十五範圍內，按月提撥勞工退休準備金 — the percentage the competent authority approved for this entity's 勞工退休準備金. Required once the entity has a worker on the old (LSA) pension system: the LABOR_PENSION_RESERVE scheme refuses the run by name while it is unrecorded; an entity with no such worker leaves it blank.

facts.label: Agreed 補休 period (months)
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §32-1(2): 補休期限由勞雇雙方協商 — the months after the day worked within which hours elected as 補休 are to be taken, as the worker and the employer agreed. Leave it unrecorded where no period was agreed: 施行細則 §22-2(1) and MOL's 加班補休規定 Q&A make the last day of the annual-leave year the final deadline, which also caps any longer agreement.

obligations.trigger: Hire, departure, start or end of unpaid leave that suspends cover

exit_facts.label: 勞基法 termination ground
exit_facts.description: The article the contract ended under. Severance is owed on §11, the §13 proviso, §14 and §20 (勞工退休金條例 §12, 勞基法 §17); notice pay on §11 and the §13 proviso (§16). OTHER owes neither. Required where the exit reason alone cannot tell the article: a dismissal (§11 owes severance, §12 does not), a unilateral or mutual termination, and a resignation (§14 owes severance, §15 does not); a redundancy or retrenchment is read as §11.

exit_facts.label: Average daily wage (平均工資)
exit_facts.description: 勞基法 §2(4): wages received in the six months before the termination day divided by the total days, excluding the periods in 施行細則 §2. Severance is 30 times this a month. Absent, a monthly-paid employee’s is read from the payslips; a daily or hourly one states it, since §2(4)’s proviso floors it at 60% of wages over the days actually worked.

exit_facts.label: Retained old-system seniority (months)
exit_facts.description: 勞工退休金條例 §11: service before the new pension system, retained, severed at one month’s average wage a year under 勞基法 §17 (a part month counts whole).

exit_facts.label: Notice days given
exit_facts.description: 勞基法 §16: calendar days from the day after notice to the last working day. The shortfall against 10 / 20 / 30 days is paid at the day wage.

work_rules.authority: 勞動基準法第24條第1項 — extended work is paid at no less than 4/3 of the ordinary hourly wage for the first two hours and 5/3 beyond, in force in this form since 2018-03-01; 第32條第2項 caps normal plus extended work at 12 hours a day, extended work at 46 hours a month and, where a union or a labour-management conference consents, at 138 hours in any three months; 第35條 gives 30 minutes' rest after four continuous hours; 第36條 gives two days' rest in every seven, one of them the 例假 that may not be worked; 第37條 and 紀念日及節日實施條例第8條 move a holiday that falls on a rest day to a 補假 rather than absorbing it; 第39條 pays a further day's wage for work on a holiday. Applied 2026-09-18: §30 the normal day is eight hours (`normal_hours`); §32(2) 54 overtime hours a month on consent (`limits[].when` over the entity fact `overtime_consent`); §35 proviso: for shift or continuous work the break is rescheduled inside working time and counts as worked (`shift_or_continuous_work`); §84-1: a NON_EA classification at an establishment with an approved 責任制 agreement is outside the overtime ladder (`responsibility_system`). Applied 2026-09-23: §24(1)(3) — hours extended under §32(4) (natural disaster, incident or emergency) are paid at double the ordinary hourly wage (`EMERGENCY-2.0X` over `emergency_cause`), and §32(2) caps only the §32(1) extension, so those hours count toward no ceiling (§36(3) says the same of rest-day work so forced); §32-1 — where the worker elects time off for a §32(1)–(2) extension or 休息日 work, the hours are credited hour for hour instead of paid (the ordinary-day and 休息日 ladders stand aside where `time_off_in_lieu` holds; not for 例假, holiday or §32(4) work, which §32-1 does not reach); hours untaken at the agreed expiry (no later than the end of the annual-leave year, 施行細則 §22-2) or on termination are paid by payroll at that day's overtime rates (`time_off_in_lieu`). Source: https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0030001

wages.authority: 最低工資法 §4–§5 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030028&flno=5): NT$29,500 a month and NT$196 an hour. `hourly_by_region` holds an hourly rate (and a part-timer’s month, pro rata to its hours) to the hourly figure, and `scale` a daily rate to the hourly figure for the contract’s normal hours a day; a monthly salary is held to the monthly figure.

ordinary_rate_reference.authority: 勞動基準法施行細則 §24-1(2)(1)(2): 一日工資，為勞工之特別休假於年度終結或契約終止前一日之正常工作時間所得之工資。其為計月者，為年度終結或契約終止前最近一個月正常工作時間所得之工資除以三十所得之金額 — the normal-hours wage actually earned in the latest month, read from that month's payslips (the wage and each normal-hours allowance as prorated, a class marked WAGES such as commission, less unpaid days; overtime is not normal-hours pay). A mid-month raise and variable normal-hours pay are therefore the month's own figures. A month no payslip settled is read from an approved employment_wage_periods record. Daily and hourly wages keep the preceding day's agreed normal wage (encashment.day_amount). https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030002&flno=24-1

encashment.day_amount: terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.pay_frequency == "WEEKLY" ? terms.basic_salary / terms.working_days_per_week + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary + terms.fixed_allowances / 30.0 : terms.monthly_wage / 30.0
encashment.authority: Labor Standards Act article 38(4); Enforcement Rules article 24-1(2). Monthly normal-working-hours pay uses the latest completed wage month, divided by 30. Hourly, daily or weekly pay uses the preceding day’s agreed normal working wage — only a wage 計月 is divided by thirty (§24-1(2)(1)(2): 其為計月者 ... 除以三十), so a weekly wage is not converted to a month; its day is the week’s normal-hours wage over the contract’s normal working days in that week; a NT$200 hourly worker with four normal hours receives NT$800 per unused day. Carried leave preserves the original year-end valuation. Normal-hours wage allowances must be classified explicitly. Source: https://www.mol.gov.tw/media/yqoj1nut/勞基法新制上路不動產經紀業調適指引.pdf?mediaDL=true

time_off_in_lieu.authority: 勞動基準法第32條之1 — where the worker chooses 補休 for a §32(1)–(2) extension or 休息日 work and the employer agrees, the hours are credited hour for hour; 補休期限由勞雇雙方協商, and hours untaken at the expiry or on termination are paid at that day's overtime rates (§32-1(2)). 施行細則第22條之2: 補休 is taken in the order the hours were worked (oldest first); an agreed period ending after the last day of the §24(2) annual-leave year ends on that day; the pay is due on the agreed pay day or within 30 days of expiry, and under §9 (immediately) on termination. MOL 加班補休規定 Q&A: the end of the annual-leave year is the final deadline and cannot be deferred. Payroll keeps the balance: each elected hour is credited on the payslip that settles its day at what its band would have paid; hours HR records as COMPENSATORY_TIME_OFF leave consume the oldest unexpired credit; a credit expires `time_off_in_lieu_months` (entity fact, the agreement) after its day, never later than the end of the ANNUAL_LEAVE year, and what is left is paid in the run whose salary window reaches the expiry or the exit. Sources: https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=32-1 ; https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030002&flno=22-2 ; https://www.mol.gov.tw/1607/28162/28166/28180/28198/28202/

final_pay_deadlines.authority: Enforcement Rules of the Labour Standards Act art.9 (settle immediately); severance within 30 days

facts.label: Overtime consent
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §32(2): a month's overtime may exceed 46 hours, to 54 (138 a quarter), only with the consent of the union or, where there is none, the labour-management conference. Unrecorded is no consent — the statute's own 46-hour month.

facts.label: Shift or continuous work
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §35: 勞工繼續工作四小時，至少應有三十分鐘之休息。但實行輪班制或其工作有連續性或緊急性者，雇主得在工作時間內，另行調配其休息時間 — true where the entity runs shifts or continuous work and so rearranges the break inside working time. Unrecorded is the rule, not its exception: false.

facts.label: Approved responsibility system
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §84-1: an approved responsibility system (責任制) for a category the central authority has announced, with a written agreement filed with the local authority, sets hours outside §30, §32, §36, §37 and §49. It is an exception that must be approved; unrecorded is none: false.

facts.label: Pension reserve rate
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §56(1): 雇主應依勞工每月薪資總額百分之二至百分之十五範圍內，按月提撥勞工退休準備金 — the percentage the competent authority approved for this entity's 勞工退休準備金. Required once the entity has a worker on the old (LSA) pension system: the LABOR_PENSION_RESERVE scheme refuses the run by name while it is unrecorded; an entity with no such worker leaves it blank.

facts.label: Agreed 補休 period (months)
facts.description: 勞動基準法 §32-1(2): 補休期限由勞雇雙方協商 — the months after the day worked within which hours elected as 補休 are to be taken, as the worker and the employer agreed. Leave it unrecorded where no period was agreed: 施行細則 §22-2(1) and MOL's 加班補休規定 Q&A make the last day of the annual-leave year the final deadline, which also caps any longer agreement.

exit_facts.label: 勞基法 termination ground
exit_facts.description: The article the contract ended under. Severance is owed on §11, the §13 proviso, §14 and §20 (勞工退休金條例 §12, 勞基法 §17); notice pay on §11 and the §13 proviso (§16). OTHER owes neither. Required where the exit reason alone cannot tell the article: a dismissal (§11 owes severance, §12 does not), a unilateral or mutual termination, and a resignation (§14 owes severance, §15 does not); a redundancy or retrenchment is read as §11.

exit_facts.label: Average daily wage (平均工資)
exit_facts.description: 勞基法 §2(4): wages received in the six months before the termination day divided by the total days, excluding the periods in 施行細則 §2. Severance is 30 times this a month. Absent, a monthly-paid employee’s is read from the payslips; a daily or hourly one states it, since §2(4)’s proviso floors it at 60% of wages over the days actually worked.

exit_facts.label: Retained old-system seniority (months)
exit_facts.description: 勞工退休金條例 §11: service before the new pension system, retained, severed at one month’s average wage a year under 勞基法 §17 (a part month counts whole).

exit_facts.label: Notice days given
exit_facts.description: 勞基法 §16: calendar days from the day after notice to the last working day. The shortfall against 10 / 20 / 30 days is paid at the day wage.
